pro_course_detail.title: Interview Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Prior to becoming a university professor, I worked in the business world. I was previously a recruiter for finance and accounting professionals and have also worked in marketing.  Through iTalki, I have worked with many global business professionals and academics to prepare for upcoming job interviews.

In our meetings, we will practice delivering effective and concise responses to various types of interview questions that go beyond technical questions related to your work (depending on your needs).  Although we can practice questions directly related to your line of work, we will most likely focus on mastering responses to questions including the following structures:
1) Tell me about yourself.
2) Tell me about a time when you. . . (describing past accomplishments and work experiences)
3) Two-part questions, e.g., Describe your leadership style, and tell me about a time where you successfully handled a conflict among your team members. 
4) Hypothetical questions, e.g., What would you do if you had an upcoming deadline that you most likely were not going to meet? 

Additionally, you can expect to receive feedback on the following: grammar, pronunciation, word choice, fluency, eye contact, body language, facial expressions, level of confidence, etc.

During our sessions, we will have a mock interview where I will assume the role of the hiring manager, and you will be the job candidate.  During the practice interview, I will take comprehensive notes on your performance. You will be provided the notes at the end of our session, and I can also give a video link to a recording of the practice interview (optional).

pro_course_detail.title: English Language Through Literature
pro_course_detail.description:
The heart of any language is in its literature. 

There, the ideas, the stories, and the unique turns-of-phrase and rhythms that built the modern spoken language lay waiting to be discovered. These great works give us a world to enter, to participate in, and ultimately to bring into ourselves. They lend themselves to a deeper understanding of the target language and allow us to build a more personal relationship with it. 

The advantages of a literary education are not only aesthetic but, above all, practical. A knowledge of literature exposes the student to a much wider and more powerful range of vocabulary than most conversational courses, while also teaching higher level grammar and syntax, greater comprehension, an ear for eloquence, and important cultural allusions. 

For this type of lesson, you are free to select any classic work of literature, poetry, philosophy, politics, etc. and I will read it with you chapter by chapter, and build lessons based upon your desired outcome. We can spend time on vocabulary, discussing or debating critical themes, or any aspect of your choice. I can also take the lead and offer a general English language literature course, or general assistance in understanding a literary work (a holistic approach). 

This course may appeal especially to college students who are struggling through a difficult English language text, though, this is truly for everyone who wants to deepen and broaden their knowledge of English, and perhaps—just perhaps—learn to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
🌟 I set clear goals for each lesson, whether it’s learning new vocabulary, mastering grammar, or improving pronunciation.

🎮 I use interactive games to help you actively use new vocabulary and make lessons fun. These activities also help conversations feel natural, so you can speak with confidence.

📅 I focus on everyday language use and take notes during the lesson. At the end of class, I offer gentle corrections to help you improve in a relaxed way.

🗣️ I love discussing topics like current events, food, pop culture, and media. I design lessons around these topics to encourage engaging conversations and a deeper understanding of the language.

course_info.trial_description:
The First Sip 🍵 

This lesson is designed to help us get to know each other and create a learning plan tailored to your goals. It will include the following:

📌 Introductions & Goals – We’ll chat about your learning style, challenges, and language goals to ensure our lessons fit your needs.

📌 Teaching Style & Lesson Structure – I’ll walk you through my teaching methods and how we can structure lessons to fast-track your progress.

📌 Mini Lesson & Practice – Based on your level and needs, we’ll briefly review a grammar topic and put it into practice through conversation.

By the end of this session, you’ll have a clearer idea of how we can work together to help you gain confidence and improve your English!

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate Conversation & Grammar Reinforcement (Conversation Café: Speak with Ease! ☕️)
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed to help intermediate learners build confidence and fluency through:

📌 Structured Discussions – I’ll provide engaging topics along with supplementary materials (short videos, articles, etc.) for you to review before class.

📌 Grammar Support – We’ll focus on key grammar concepts based on your individual needs. I’ll tailor lessons to areas where you need more practice, helping you develop better habits for both speaking and writing.

📌 Gentle Corrections – At the end of each class, we’ll review any grammar or pronunciation mistakes and create a plan to track your progress in future lessons.
